name: Vegetarian Sopes

ingredients.name: vegetarian crumbly fresh cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

steps: Mix masa harina with salt, then add the warm water gradually and knead for 2 minutes into a soft dough that holds together without sticking. Rest covered for 15 minutes so the corn flour hydrates. If the dough cracks when pressed, work in a little of the measured water; if sticky, rest a little longer.

Divide the dough into eight equal balls. Flatten each between two sheets of plastic or baking paper into a thick round about 9–10 cm across and 8–10 mm thick. Heat a dry heavy griddle over medium heat and cook each round for about 2 minutes per side until the surface sets and light brown marks appear.

While the rounds are still warm but safe to handle, use a clean cloth to protect your fingers and pinch a raised rim all the way around each edge, making a shallow bowl. Brush the griddle lightly with the measured oil and return the shaped sopes, base-side down, for 2–3 minutes until their bottoms are lightly crisp and the centres cook through.

Warm the vegetarian refried beans until spreadable. Verify that the crumbly cheese is made with vegetarian coagulants. Spread about 40 g beans inside each raised rim, then divide the shredded lettuce and thick tomato salsa evenly among the eight sopes. Add the cheese, a spoonful of crema and chopped coriander to each.

Serve immediately, two sopes per person, while the thick corn bases are warm and the lettuce remains crisp. Lift them by their firm raised edges; these are open topped masa cakes, not folded tacos or flat crisp tostadas.
tips: Masa harina is nixtamalized corn flour; ordinary coarse cornmeal will not form the same smooth dough. Pinch the rim while warm, before the masa becomes rigid. The reviewed photo clearly shows four thick, raised-rim corn cakes with beans, lettuce, tomato, white cheese and crema.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
